notes: answer is scored per field (spy / changed_attributes) so a collapsed count cannot hide behind a correct spy. grounding pays overlap only (no unconditional format floor) and uses box-F1 so extra boxes cost; warmup_steps=0 keeps that pressure on from the first step. consistency checks the trajectory against itself rather than against its rollout group, which is constant within a group and therefore has no gradient. gating=spy: the auxiliary dims pay only on rollouts that identified the outlier image.
